Review Text: Booked the 45-min private air tour with my teen. The airport was easy to find with plenty of parking. We arrived 30 min early as directed, but the tour ahead of ours was running late. So we ended up waiting for over an hour (which wasn't a big deal, but we weren't prepared for). The plane was also a bit "worn" (peeling paint, older interior, my headset didn't work). However our pilot was very calm and confident and once in the air, everything went smoothly. I think the pilot pointed out landmarks, but I was unable to hear him (just heard chatter from other pilots/airports). It was also very warm in the plane (we were there in mid-June). In the end, my son & I both got some amazing photos or places I used to go as a child, which made it well worth it for me.
